speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type (or Delusional Disorder, Unspecified)

The patient's belief that he *cannot* communicate telepathically after previously being able to do so, coupled with the belief that weather conditions affect this ability, represents a fixed false belief (a delusion) rather than a true hallucination. Since the neuropsychological assessment and MRI brain were normal, this is likely a primary psychiatric condition rather than an organic neurological or psychotic disorder.
